newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar pares gains in evening trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar pares gains in evening trade.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures pared gains in evening trading to continue the easier tone of the afternoon, traders said.
August hit a high of $323 during the morning but at the 1730 GMT close it was just $0.50 ahead at $321.70 on volume of 823 lots, making it the most active month.
The October was up $1.10 at $317.40 on 684 lots.
In Paris, the August contract closed at $322.00 up $1.50 and the October gained $2.10 to $317.40.
London failed to respond to an early rally in New York, as US traders followed through on Monday's higher close.

Brazil's key port of Santos was partially paralyzed by an indefinite strike involving a group of administrative workers which began at 0100 local/0400 GMT today, a CODESP port authority spokesman said.
Some 23 ships docked in CODESP berths have been hit by the strike, including eight ships loading bagged sugar and one loading bulk sugar, CODESP said.
